description: A school is organizing a field trip to a science center and wants to hire small buses and large buses. A small bus can carry 20 students while a large bus can carry 50 students.  The school needs to provide transportation for at least 500 students.  In addition, since the parking lot is rather small, a maximum of 20% of the buses can be large buses. How many of each type of bus should be hired to minimize the total number of buses?

MinimumStudents.definition: Minimum number of students to transport

MaxLargeBusPercentage.definition: Maximum percentage of buses that can be large buses

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of buses hired (small buses plus large buses)"

constraints.description: 20 * (Number of small buses) + 50 * (Number of large buses) >= MinimumStudents
(Number of large buses) <= MaxLargeBusPercentage * (Number of small buses + Number of large buses)
Number of small buses >= 0, Number of large buses >= 0
Number of small buses and number of large buses must be integers
